Xiao Ming watches this process, seems to understand Xiao Liu's intention, and nods.

[Question]
What does Xiao Ming do?

[Candidate Answers]
A. Tell Xiao Liu not to invite Xiao Yun.
B. Let Xiao Liu invite Xiao Yun.
